candidate_role: Copy spell and graveyard-recoverable combo support
commander_specific_hypothesis: Galvanic Iteration copies the next instant or sorcery spell cast that turn and has flashback. Cormela can return it from the graveyard when she dies; it can copy Brain Freeze, Tendrils of Agony, or Mizzix's Mastery.
expected_benefit: Raises the ceiling of the deck's existing spell-based finishes and adds a reusable instant for Cormela's death trigger.
tradeoff: Grapeshot is a low-cost storm payoff and creature-removal option; cutting it reduces a redundant win condition, while Galvanic Iteration needs a second spell and does not itself win.
